name: Document - Incoming Document Handler

parameters.query: WITH ins AS (INSERT INTO {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.document_incoming (id, so_van_ban, noi_gui, ngay_nhan, trich_yeu, file_url, assignee_id, status) VALUES (COALESCE(NULLIF($1::text, '')::uuid, gen_random_uuid()), COALESCE(NULLIF($2::text, ''), 'VB-' || TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')), COALESCE(NULLIF($3::text, ''), 'Ngoại bộ'), COALESCE(NULLIF($4::text, '')::date, CURRENT_DATE), COALESCE(NULLIF($5::text, ''), 'Văn bản đến'), NULLIF($6::text, ''), CASE WHEN COALESCE($7::text, '') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN ($7::text)::uuid ELSE NULL END, 'received') ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT id FROM ins), NULLIF($1::text, '')::uuid) AS id;
SELECT mattermost_user_id FROM users WHERE COALESCE($1::text, '') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND id = ($1::text)::uuid;

parameters.responseBody: ={"success": true, "doc_id": "{{$('Save Document').item.json.id || $('Generate Doc Code').item.json.id || ''}}", "doc_code": "{{$('Generate Doc Code').item.json.doc_code}}"}
